question: Total revenue for Chilled in Canterbury
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_nzd), 2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_date d USING(date_key) WHERE s.region = 'Canterbury' AND p.category = 'Chilled'

question: Revenue by region
sql: SELECT s.region, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_nzd), 2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_date d USING(date_key) GROUP BY s.region ORDER BY revenue DESC

question: Frozen revenue in 2026-08
sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_nzd), 2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_date d USING(date_key) WHERE p.category = 'Frozen' AND d.month = '2026-08'

question: Revenue by category in Auckland
sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(f.revenue_nzd), 2) AS revenue FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_date d USING(date_key) WHERE s.region = 'Auckland' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC
